name: Products
description: Photos of products, one card per product however many photos it has.

guidance.context: Each card is one product, from one or more photos of it or its packaging.

fields.instruction: The product's name as printed on it, its brand included.
The brand on the product or its packaging.

screenshots.caption: The board: one card per product, however many photos it has.
One product's card: its photos together, its name and brand, its category.
